description: This file is a shell script intended as a library for testing Git's daemon functionality. It provides functions to start and stop a git daemon, check prerequisites, and simulate network connectivity with a simplified netcat-like client.

methods.name: start_git_daemon
methods.description: Function to initialize and start the git daemon for testing, ensuring it is not already running and setting up necessary environment and cleanup handlers.

methods.name: stop_git_daemon
methods.description: Function to stop the running git daemon and clean up associated resources.

methods.name: fake_nc
methods.description: A simplified netcat-like client implemented in Perl for testing network connectivity to the git daemon.
